## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

## Proposed solution

How would you like ileDelbe to help? A sketch or a mockup is welcome.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, or other apps that do this well.

## Anything else

ileDelbe aims to stay small and light (nothing runs while idle). Tell us if your idea needs a new permission or background work.
